issues.title: [Docs] GXMCP_SHARED_CHILD usada no shared-host sem entrada em docs/environment_variables.md
[Bug] shared-host: broker writes the Worker's stdin in the ANSI/OEM code page, so non-ASCII arguments arrive as U+FFFD (accented patch `find` never matches; accented writes at risk)
[Bug] ISO-8601 string arguments are parsed as JSON dates and rejected by schema validation (`since` / `modifiedBefore` unusable)
[Bug] `genexus_analyze mode=callers` never matches `Obj.Call(` / `.Udp(` / `.Submit(` / `.Link(`, so every lookup ends as `CallerSitesUnconfirmed`
[Bug] Worker still writes build logs, job state and rotated logs under its install directory (npx cache)
[Perf] Every successful write echoes the whole persisted part (`result.source`): ~35 KB median response for a ~115-char patch
[Perf] Exact-identity reads are blocked until the index is `freshness=current`, causing multi-minute stalls at session start on large KBs
[Design] One operation model for long lifecycle actions: honor `wait_until_done` on `specify`, queue instead of `BuildAlreadyRunning`, delta status, single id namespace
[Perf] Source search: persisted source is capped at 8 MiB, so unscoped `search_source` falls back to an SDK scan (~13 objects/s) and times out at 1-2% coverage
[Design] STA scheduler: priorities, cooperative slicing and bounded waits instead of instant `WorkerBusy` (critical for shared-host)
[Ops] Run the Gateway/Worker from a staged, versioned runtime instead of the npx cache (upgrade `EBUSY` → `CONNECTION_CLOSED`)
[DX] Contract papercuts: batch `properties get`, typed `PartNotFound` listing Rules, missing near-match diagnostics on `NoMatch`
[Perf] Default tool surface costs ~134 KB of schema per session: lean default profile and per-profile budgets
[Tracking] Field review of the end-to-end MCP flow: bottlenecks found and suggested order of work (#285-#296)
genexus_io import_part part=Variables silently strips the module qualifier from SDT variables, and reports WriteNotPersisted while saving
[Docs] Document shared Worker driver and provider environment variables
[Bug] import_part reports WriteNotPersisted when the only difference is CRLF vs LF — isolates the unexplained transformation in #265
[Bug/DX] genexus_search_source silently ignores an unknown argument instead of rejecting it, turning a scoped search into a full-KB scan
[Regression of #225] KB_LEASE_EXPIRED still hits genexus_lifecycle mid-session on 3.8.0 / GeneXus 18
